media.title: Wikipedia: Lyon Gardiner Tyler
media.note: Lyon Gardiner Tyler Sr. (August 24, 1853 – February 12, 1935) was an American educator, politician, genealogist, and historian.

media.title: Lyon Gardiner Tyler in academic dress (frontispiece, Encyclopedia of Virginia Biography vol. IV)

bio: Lyon Gardiner Tyler was born in 1853 at Sherwood Forest Plantation in Charles City County, Virginia, a son of President Tyler and his wife Juliana, in whose family he is listed as 'Lyon-G.'. He became the 17th president of the College of William & Mary and died in 1935. He was John's 6th cousin 5 times removed.
researchNotes: 6th cousin 5 times removed; listed as son 'Lyon-G.' of Juliana and President Tyler ([R4-S1]).
